entries.title: Psalms 4:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm of David.>> When I call, answer me, O God of my righteousness: in pressure thou hast enlarged me; be gracious unto me, and hear my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 4:2
segments: Ye sons of men, till when is my glory [to be put] to shame? [How long] will ye love vanity, will ye seek after a lie? Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 4:3
segments: But know that Jehovah hath set apart the pious [man] for himself: Jehovah will hear when I call unto him.

entries.title: Psalms 4:4
segments: Be moved with anger, and sin not; meditate in your own hearts upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 4:5
segments: Offer sacrifices of righteousness, and confide in Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 4:6
segments: ¶Many say, Who shall cause us to see good? Lift up upon us the light of thy countenance, O Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 4:7
segments: Thou hast put joy in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their new wine was in abundance.

entries.title: Psalms 4:8
segments: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; for thou, Jehovah, alone makest me to dwell in safety.
